# HDFC Mutual Fund AMC Overview
**Category:** AMC Overview | **Source:** https://groww.in/mutual-funds/amc/hdfc-mutual-funds

## Key Scheme Facts & Metrics
- **Fund House:** HDFC Asset Management Company Limited (HDFC Mutual Fund)
- **Rank:** #2 in India by AUM
- **Total Aum:** ₹9,34,075.66 Cr
- **Incorporation Date:** 10 Dec 1999 (SEBI Registration: June 30, 2000)
- **Sponsor:** Housing Development Finance Corporation Limited (HDFC Ltd / HDFC Bank)
- **Ceo:** Navneet Munot
- **Statement Download Guide:** To download mutual fund capital-gains or account statement on Groww: 1. Log in to the Groww app or web portal. 2. Click on Profile Icon and navigate to 'Reports'. 3. Select 'Mutual Funds Reports' -> 'Capital Gains Statement'. 4. Select the Financial Year and choose PDF or Excel format. 5. Click 'Download' or 'Send to Email'. Alternatively, on official HDFC AMC portal (hdfcfund.com), navigate to Investor Services -> Account Statement, enter PAN or Folio number to receive the statement via registered email.

## About HDFC Mutual Fund
HDFC Mutual Fund is one of India's largest and most established Asset Management Companies. It was established as a joint venture between HDFC and Standard Life Investments. HDFC AMC manages over ₹9.34 Lakh Crore across equity, debt, hybrid, and solution-oriented schemes.

## Capital Gains Statement Download Procedure
Steps to download statement: In Groww app, go to Profile -> Reports -> Capital Gains Statement. Select the desired financial year and click Download. For official AMC direct statement, visit HDFC AMC portal under Investor Services -> Account Statement.

## AMC Leadership & Governance
Managing Director & CEO: Navneet Munot. Chief Investment Officer: Prashant Jain (historical) / Senior Fund Managers including Chirag Setalvad, Roshi Jain, Rahul Baijal, and Gopal Agrawal.

Official Source Link: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/amc/hdfc-mutual-funds

# HDFC Large Cap Fund Direct Growth
**Category:** Large Cap | **Source:** https://groww.in/mutual-funds/hdfc-large-cap-fund-direct-growth

## Key Scheme Facts & Metrics
- **Expense Ratio:** 1.02%
- **Exit Load:** 1% if redeemed within 1 year; Nil after 1 year (365 days)
- **Min Sip:** ₹100
- **Min Lumpsum:** ₹100
- **Lock In:** Nil (Open-ended equity scheme)
- **Riskometer:** Very High Risk
- **Benchmark:** NIFTY 100 Total Return Index (TRI)
- **Fund Manager:** Rahul Baijal
- **Launch Date:** 10 Dec 1999
- **Stamp Duty:** 0.005% on mutual fund unit purchases

## Investment Objective
The scheme seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation and income by investing predominantly in large-cap companies. The fund invests at least 80% of total assets in top 100 companies by market capitalization.

## Expense Ratio & Exit Load
Expense ratio is 1.02% (Direct Plan). Exit load is 1% if redeemed within 1 year (365 days) from allotment; Nil if redeemed after 1 year. Stamp duty is 0.005% on purchases.

## Minimum Investment & Liquidity
Minimum SIP investment is ₹100. Minimum Lumpsum investment is ₹100. There is no statutory lock-in period; units can be redeemed on any business day.

## Riskometer & Benchmark
Riskometer rating is Very High. Benchmark index is NIFTY 100 Total Return Index (TRI).

Official Source Link: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/hdfc-large-cap-fund-direct-growth

# HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth
**Category:** ELSS (Tax Saver) | **Source:** https://groww.in/mutual-funds/hdfc-elss-tax-saver-fund-direct-plan-growth

## Key Scheme Facts & Metrics
- **Expense Ratio:** 1.12%
- **Exit Load:** Nil (Subject to mandatory 3-year statutory lock-in period)
- **Lock In:** 3 Years mandatory statutory lock-in period from the date of allotment under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act
- **Tax Deduction:** Eligible for tax deduction up to ₹1.5 Lakh per financial year under Section 80C
- **Min Sip:** ₹500
- **Min Lumpsum:** ₹500
- **Riskometer:** Very High Risk
- **Benchmark:** NIFTY 500 Total Return Index (TRI)
- **Fund Manager:** Roshi Jain
- **Launch Date:** 01 Jan 2013 (Direct Plan) / 31 Mar 1996 (Inception)
- **Stamp Duty:** 0.005% on mutual fund unit purchases

## Investment Objective
To generate capital appreciation and income from a portfolio of predominantly equity-oriented investments while providing tax deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, 1961.

## Lock-in Period & Tax Rules
Statutory lock-in period is 3 years from the date of allotment under Section 80C. No redemption, transfer, or switch-out of units is permitted until the 3-year period expires. Investments qualify for tax deduction up to ₹1,50,000 annually under Section 80C.

## Expense Ratio & Exit Load
Expense ratio is 1.12% (Direct Plan). Exit load is Nil after completion of the 3-year lock-in period.

## Minimum Investment & Riskometer
Minimum SIP is ₹500 and Minimum Lumpsum is ₹500. Riskometer classification is Very High. Benchmark is NIFTY 500 Total Return Index (TRI).

Official Source Link: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/hdfc-elss-tax-saver-fund-direct-plan-growth
